## Details
### **SW-REQ-BARO-001** — Support 20 Hz Altimeter Sampling

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall deliver pressure samples at 20 Hz.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-008; library throughput must support the system-mandated 20 Hz altimeter sample rate.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-008
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-002** — Report Pressure in Pascals

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall report pressure measurements in pascals.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042; SI units throughout requires pressure to be expressed in pascals.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-042
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-003** — Report Temperature in Degrees Celsius

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall report temperature measurements in degrees Celsius.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042; SI units throughout requires temperature to be expressed in degrees Celsius.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-042
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-004** — Report Derived Altitude in Meters

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall report a derived altitude measurement in meters.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-042; SI units throughout requires altitude to be expressed in meters; reference frame defined in design.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-042
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-005** — Power-On Self-Test Device Probe

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall report at startup whether the altimeter device is present and responsive.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-029; POST requires probing each sensor device once at startup including the barometric altimeter.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-029
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-006** — Continuous Altimeter Health Reporting

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall publish a health indicator reflecting whether device samples are flowing.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-031; continuous per-sensor health bitmap requires the library to surface its data-flow state.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-031
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-007** — Read Failure Status Reporting

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall return a failure status code when a read from the altimeter fails.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-058; explicit failure status enables the caller to flag sensor unhealthy. Status return enables the caller to satisfy SYS-033 continuation.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-058
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-008** — Non-Blocking Read Interface

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall provide a non-blocking read interface that returns within a caller-supplied timeout.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-044; deterministic execution requires the library never to block the TDM scheduler indefinitely.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-044
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-009** — POSIX Implementation Functional Equivalence

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall provide a POSIX implementation functionally equivalent to the Pico2 implementation.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; Trick simulation requires POSIX builds that exercise the same library API as flight.
- **Verification Method:** Test
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1

### **SW-REQ-BARO-010** — Pico2 Implementation for Flight Hardware

- **Description:** The barometric altimeter library shall provide a Pico2 implementation that reads samples from the flight altimeter device.
- **Rationale:** Decomposes SW-REQ-SYS-043; flight hardware build requires a Pico2 implementation paired with the POSIX implementation.
- **Verification Method:** Demonstration
- **Status:** Active
- **Parent:** SW-REQ-SYS-043
- **Children:** None
- **Tags:** FT1
